facebook.content:
“Seek first the Kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.” — Matt 6:33  

The world rushes, but the Kingdom advances on the ground of obedience. When we prioritize God’s reign today, provision follows not by chance but by divine order.  

What Kingdom‑first priority will you claim this week?

instagram.content:
“Your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.” — Matthew 6:10  
The Kingdom isn’t a future dream; it’s a present mandate. When we submit every decision to Christ’s lordship, the world shifts to reflect Heaven’s order.  

What area of your life will you surrender today to see God’s Kingdom break through?
